# Token Monitor Platform

> Lightweight AI API Token usage monitoring, cost estimation, and proxy platform.

Token Monitor Platform is an open-source solution designed for tracking, managing, and analyzing token consumption across multi-provider LLM deployments. It offers proxy routing, user authentication, and real-time token and cost analytics.

## Supported Providers

- **OpenAI**: Compatible with `gpt-4`, `gpt-4o`, `gpt-3.5-turbo`, embeddings, and fine-tuned models. Default API endpoint: `https://api.openai.com/v1`
- **Anthropic**: Support for Claude models (`claude-3-5-sonnet`, `claude-3-opus`, `claude-3-haiku`). Default API endpoint: `https://api.anthropic.com`
- **Google Gemini**: Support for Gemini models (`gemini-1.5-pro`, `gemini-1.5-flash`). Default API endpoint: `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com`
- **Azure OpenAI & Custom Providers**: Supports custom base URLs and custom pricing configurations for enterprise proxying.

## Key Features

- **Real-Time Token Tracking**: Monitors input/prompt tokens, output/completion tokens, and request counts per provider and model.
- **Cost Calculation**: Automated cost estimation based on configurable per-model input and output token pricing rules.
- **Proxy Adapter**: OpenAI-compatible chat completion proxy router at `/api/proxy/:platformId/chat` for seamless request tracking and header-based key decryption.
- **Quota & Usage Alerts**: Alerts when usage exceeds defined thresholds or monthly quotas.
- **Security**: AES-256-CBC key encryption for stored API keys, JWT authentication for platform access.

## Core API Endpoints

### Authentication
- `POST /api/auth/register`: Register a new user account.
- `POST /api/auth/login`: Authenticate user and retrieve JWT access token.
- `POST /api/auth/logout`: End active session.
- `GET /api/auth/profile`: Retrieve user profile information.

### Platform Management
- `GET /api/platforms`: List configured provider platforms.
- `POST /api/platforms`: Configure a new platform (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure, etc.).
- `GET /api/platforms/:id`: Fetch platform configuration details.
- `PUT /api/platforms/:id`: Update platform API key, base URL, pricing, or quotas.
- `DELETE /api/platforms/:id`: Remove platform configuration.

### Usage & Analytics
- `GET /api/usage/logs`: Query usage logs with pagination and filters (date range, platform, model).
- `GET /api/usage/stats`: Retrieve aggregated token and cost statistics (today and all-time).
- `POST /api/usage/report`: Report token usage manually from external services or SDKs.
- `GET /api/analytics/daily`: Aggregated daily usage trends for reporting and charting.

### API Proxy
- `POST /api/proxy/:platformId/chat`: OpenAI-compatible proxy endpoint. Forwards request payload to configured platform target, logs prompt and completion tokens automatically, and returns response.

## Architecture & Deployment

- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL.
- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Ant Design, Recharts, Zustand.
- **Containerization**: One-command deployment via Docker Compose (`docker-compose up -d`).
